items.title: Report warns Polymarket military markets show insider-trading risk, with 152 wallets winning 8 million dollars, GambleRss reports
items.content_text: - **Report warns Polymarket military markets show insider-trading risk, with 152 wallets winning 8 million dollars, GambleRss reports** — An Anti-Corruption Data Collective report identified 152 wallets on Polymarket's international platform that primarily traded US military event contracts, placing about 2 million dollars in longshot trades and winning about 8 million dollars at a 97.2 percent win rate.
